headline: EU Kids Act would bar under-13s from social media
summary: Two outlets report the EU's proposed Kids Act, which would ban social media access for children under 13. One calls it the most sweeping proposal yet; the other's text raises age checks, parental oversight and privacy as obstacles to implementing it.
